representation.q_domain: nonnegative integers, including odd q for F = a phi

physical_assembly.F: value angular prefix multiplied by symbolic q=1 channel
physical_assembly.E: sqrt(2*X) * F, exact zero at X=0
physical_assembly.U: ordinary(4*eta+j) + axial prefix shifted by Lambda^-1
physical_assembly.dU_deta: ordinary(4) + eta_order=1 axial prefix shifted by Lambda^-1
physical_assembly.average_U: ordinary(4*eta+j) + radial-average axial prefix shifted by Lambda^-1
physical_assembly.d_average_U_deta: ordinary(4) + eta_order=1 radial-average axial prefix shifted by Lambda^-1
physical_assembly.Pi: quadrature axis pressure + primitive pressure prefix shifted by Lambda^-1

transport_geometry.L: 1 - 2*h*eta^2, validated positive on the physical chart

conditional_bound_api.d_average_U_deta: eta_order=1 averaged tail divided by Lambda
conditional_bound_api.V0: exact-Fraction triangle bound from X, eta, D, h, and positive L, rounded upward at final Decimal96 conversion

validation: one actual-axis wide-prefix smoke target; reciprocal Decimal inputs can retain their finite-product residual
conditional bounds use exact Fraction scaling and upward Decimal conversion
layer.remaining_boundary: The finite prefix leaves an unknown radial tail and does not prove global AxisSpace membership, fixed-point convergence, paper-exact velocity, forcing, or a physical-coordinate theorem profile. Decimal96 arithmetic is not exact real arithmetic or an interval certificate.

forbidden_promotions: forming a^q or Lambda^-p as a floating-point value
dropping nonzero sparse channels or projecting to binary64
treating the schedule axis-pressure quadrature as the remainder pressure forcing
treating conditional omitted-row bounds as unconditional AxisSpace certification
claiming paper exactness, fixed-point convergence, or global profile membership
